title: FSM Resets to IDLE Instead of Required BOOT State
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [INIT] state=IDLE on reset release; expected BOOT; self-test sequence skipped
expected_root_cause: The reset branch assigns state to IDLE rather than the architecturally required BOOT state; the power-on self-test that runs through BOOT is never executed, leaving hardware self-checks permanently bypassed.
description: The design specification requires the FSM to enter a BOOT state on reset to run self-test before accepting commands; the implementation resets to IDLE instead, skipping the BOOT self-test entirely.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [INIT] state=IDLE on reset release; expected BOOT; self-test sequence skipped
success_log: state=BOOT after reset. Self-test sequence completes before FSM enters IDLE.
